findings.title: Speech energy latch cleared on interrupt without controller re-apply
findings.resolution: Keep speechEnergyTarget on interrupted; snap speechEnergy only; re-assert setSpeechEnergy on speaking entry; regression test added.

findings.title: Auto-gesture nextGestureAt not reset when re-entering speaking
findings.resolution: Reset nextGestureAt to 2.8 on speaking entry; covered by regression test.

findings.title: destroy() during async init can resurrect avatar
findings.resolution: destroyed guard in init; post-init teardown; destroy delegates to teardownRenderer.
